gap:logistic_l2_optimization.statement: Determine which L2 regularization strength (lambda in [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0]) produces the lowest 5-fold cross-validated Brier score for logistic regression

gap:interaction_feature_significance.statement: Determine if interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) significantly improve logistic regression performance via paired t-test across folds

gap:compression_performance_tradeoff.statement: Find optimal compression configuration (sparsity and quantization) that best retains dense model performance
